heading_en: Classification of Risk Factors into Risk Buckets
summary_ja: リスク・ファクターをリスク・バケットに分類する方法(内部管理上のバケット又は告示所定のバケット)と、満期等の区分表を定める。
summary_en: Provides the methods of classifying risk factors into risk buckets (internal buckets or the prescribed buckets) and sets the maturity, option expiry and strike category tables.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach shall classify risk factors into risk buckets by either of the following methods. (i) A method of classifying them into the risk buckets used in internal management. (ii) A method of classifying them into the risk buckets prescribed in paragraph (3).

Where the method listed in item (i) of the preceding paragraph is used, all of the following requirements shall be satisfied and the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency shall be obtained. (i) A risk factor is classified into one risk bucket. (ii) Risk buckets do not overlap.

Where the method listed in paragraph (1), item (ii) is used, risk factors shall be classified into the risk buckets prescribed in the following items according to the category of type of risk factor listed in those items. (i) General interest rate, foreign exchange and commodity risk factors with one maturity category (excluding implied volatility): the risk buckets prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the maturity category listed in the upper column of that table. {{T:p326t0}} (ii) General interest rate, foreign exchange and commodity risk factors with multiple maturity categories (excluding implied volatility): the risk buckets prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the maturity category listed in the upper column of that table. {{T:p326t1}} (iii) Credit spread risk and equity risk factors with one or more maturity categories (excluding implied volatility): the risk buckets prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the maturity category listed in the upper column of that table. {{T:p327t1}} (iv) Risk factors with one or more strike price categories: the risk buckets prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the category of sensitivity to the underlying asset listed in the upper column of that table. {{T:p327t2}} (v) Implied volatility risk factors with option expiry categories and strike price categories (excluding those for interest rate swaptions): the risk buckets prescribed in the following table according to the categories of sensitivity to the underlying asset and maturity listed in that table. {{T:p327t3}} (vi) Implied volatility risk factors for interest rate swaptions with maturity categories, option expiry categories and strike price categories: risk buckets created by combinations of the maturity category, the option expiry category and the strike price category.

"Maturity category," "option expiry category" and "strike price category" in item (vi) of the preceding paragraph mean those prescribed in the tables of the following items, respectively. (i) Table of maturity categories {{T:p328t1}} (ii) Table of option expiry categories {{T:p328t2}} (iii) Table of strike price categories {{T:p328t3}}

Where the method listed in paragraph (1), item (ii) is used and a debt instrument has matured within the most recent twelve months, the real price observations identified during that period shall be classified into the original risk bucket category.

Where the method listed in paragraph (1), item (ii) is used and it is no longer necessary to model a credit spread risk factor belonging to the risk bucket of a particular maturity, it may be classified into the risk bucket adjacent to that risk bucket that has the shorter maturity category.
